summary: @servicetitan/cp-mfe preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs constructs a platform-specific URL of the form https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip, downloads and extracts the Bun binary to a tempdir, chmods it 0755, and then execFileSyncs the freshly-downloaded Bun against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-file bundle marked with a @bun/@bun-cjs header and is heavily obfuscated: string-array rotation (WV8StW), a large numeric/char string-array (n7gIxM), and a decoder (hc1jfK9) over a shuffled alphabet, with hex-mangled identifiers. The advertised library surface in dist/ is a small React/mobx micro-frontend (events, provide, portal.store) with peerDependencies on react, mobx, and react-router-dom — a purpose that has no functional need for a second JavaScript runtime or an opaque install-time init blob. On npm install, the obfuscated payload runs under an alien runtime that bypasses Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
